findings.evidence: ZeroOneForm/Basic.lean:279 already has `instance zeroOneSobolevSections.instCompleteSpace`; the PR description says 'The public statement cannot use private instances.'
findings.fix: Make them public instances in `ZeroOneForm/Basic.lean`, next to `zeroOneSobolevSections.instCompleteSpace`. Then state `exists_eLpNorm_le_of_forall_eq_setIntegral` with `C * ‖Λ‖` and drop the `K`/`hK`/`hΛ` detour.
findings.issue: The private instances `instNormedAddCommGroupZeroOneSobolevSections`/`instNormedSpaceZeroOneSobolevSections` work around a failed nested instance search locally. They hide a reusable fix and force the public theorem to take `K` with `hK` instead of `‖Λ‖`.

findings.evidence: In the main theorem: `have hQ'' ... := by rw [A.image_tangentHom]; exact hQ'.trans (subset_closure.trans hQi)`; `apply_antilinearExtL_eq` repeats this as `hQt` and `hQs`.
findings.fix: Factor out a small lemma, e.g. `closure Q' ⊆ Q → closure Q ⊆ A.image i → closure Q' ⊆ A.tangentHom.image i`, plus its `sectionChartData` variant. Use it in place of the extra binder and the repeated `rw [A.image_tangentHom]; exact ...` blocks.
findings.issue: `apply_antilinearExtL_eq` and `eLpNorm_apply_le` take `hQ'' : closure Q' ⊆ A.tangentHom.image i`, which follows from `hQi` and `hQ'`. The same image fact is re-derived as `hQt`/`hQs` inside `apply_antilinearExtL_eq` and as `hQ''` in the main theorem.

summary: The proofs are readable and well commented, but two private instances work around a failed instance search instead of fixing it publicly, which forces the public statement to take a bound K instead of ‖Λ‖. Two private lemmas also take a redundant hypothesis hQ''.
